desc: The Oryx LRF XG35 offers fully adjustable brightness and contrast settings, allowing users to fine-tune their viewing experience. Featuring a 2.5x to 20x digital zoom; equipped with an integrated laser rangefinder that provides precise distance measurements up to 1640 yards; powered by a removable APS5 Li-ion battery pack (4900 mAh), the Oryx LRF XG35 provides up to 12 hours of continuous operation. For extended use, the device supports USB Type-C external power delivery, ensuring uninterrupted performance during long hunting trips, tactical missions or surveillance operations.
